people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.
translations.bsb: Then the whole town went out to meet Jesus. And when they saw Him, they begged Him to leave their region.
translations.kjv: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.
translations.asv: And behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart from their borders.
